'''Malaxan Firepower Incorporated''' was a company that manufactured projectile and energy weapons during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One of their products was the [[FWG-5 Flechette Smart Pistol]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
